## DBA review checklist

- [ ] Index name follows the team standard
- [ ] Duplicate and overlapping indexes were checked
- [ ] Write overhead was considered
- [ ] Fill factor was reviewed
- [ ] Online option was reviewed for the target SQL Server version and edition
- [ ] Rollback plan is included
- [ ] Change was tested in a non-production environment
- [ ] Execution plan is attached
